notes.subject: khesed
notes.rationale: חסד i stap olsem 'khesed' — marimari tasol i no minim gutpela (D2)

notes.subject: בימינך
notes.rationale: Sam tanim (KJV, ASV) i putim 'han sut' olsem instrumen bilong sevim; sam (YLT, JPS) olsem ples we ol birua i stap — Hebrew i lef i op

translation: Mekim ol khesed bilong yu i sanap gutpela tru, yu bilong pulapim ol man i save ran long yu long han sut bilong yu, olsem ol i kirap long ol.

tokens.gloss: ol man i save ran long yu
olsem ol i kirap long ol
